moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio svg-gooey-merge, written here): Two circles r 26 px in a group with a goo filter (Gaussian blur 7 px, then alpha x 22 - 9). Centres start +-64 px from the middle, hold 300 ms, move to +-22 px over 1000 ms easeInOut (a neck forms before contact), hold 900 ms, return over 900 ms. One fill colour. Params: distance (±64 → ±22 px) · blur (7 px) · threshold (22a − 9) · color. The two circles sit in a group with a goo filter: Gaussian blur 7, then alpha × 22 − 9 (feColorMatrix).
